title: Add parent_id field to backlog item schema and data model
description: Extend backlog-item.schema.json with an optional parent_id field (string or null). Update project-index.js buildBacklogEntry to pass through parent_id. Update project-dashboard.js to include parent_id in item output. Update project-dashboard.output.schema.json to include parent_id. Existing backlog items without parent_id must continue to work (default null). The type 'epic' becomes meaningful: epics are items that have children referencing them via parent_id.
stop_condition: parent_id field exists in backlog-item schema. project-index and project-dashboard expose it. Existing items without parent_id default to null. All tests pass.
